items.headline: Tyler Fredricson departs United to join FC Lausanne-Sport
items.summary: Centre-back Tyler Fredricson has left Manchester United on a permanent basis to join FC Lausanne-Sport for an undisclosed fee. The Swiss club is under Ineos ownership.

items.headline: Sesko 'getting there' with recovery
items.summary: Benjamin Sesko is progressing in his recovery from injury and will be monitored ahead of upcoming fixtures.

items.headline: United confirm squad for Atletico Madrid friendly
items.summary: Manchester United have named a 23-man squad for the pre-season friendly against Atletico Madrid, with two first-team players returning.

items.headline: Rosenborg v United squad selection announced
items.summary: Manchester United have released their squad selection for the pre-season fixture against Rosenborg.
